The path then learns to develop Azure compute solutions, monitor and troubleshoot Azure solutions, and develop for Azure storage. It applies data engineering skills by learning to deploy web and mobile GIS applications, skills in satellite data acquisition, classification, and temporal analysis. The path continues by developing skills in rapid prototyping, including knowledge of materials and tools used for rapid prototyping. It applies rapid prototyping skills by learning to differentiate alternative approaches to social policy problems, critique components of a social policy, and apply concepts and tools to advance energy justice. Finally, it learns to design and redesign energy systems to put justice at the center, recognizing energy injustice, and applying concepts and tools to advance energy justice.
